# OverCue Desktop 2.2.15 for Windows

- Fix DJM-A9 stems EQ being unavailable when the mixer channel uses LINE input. DIGITAL input remains supported, with the same meter indicator and independent 12-o'clock EQ pickup.
- To apply this fix to your mixer, open Mixers → DJM-A9, patch the official 1.22 firmware again, and install the newly generated update. Updating the app alone does not change the mixer. CDJ-3000 firmware 0.12.0 already supports this fix.
